title: American Inventors: Rocket Scientist Robert Goddard
summary: Орчин үеийн пуужингийн эцэг гэгддэг эрдэмтэн Роберт Годдардын тухай.

source.name: VOA Learning English
source.credit: Shirley Griffith, Bryan Lynn · VOA Learning English
source.creditLine: Shirley Griffith reported on this story for VOA Learning English. Bryan Lynn adapted it.

questions.prompt: What is Robert Goddard known for?
questions.explain: NASA түүнийг "the father of modern rocket propulsion" гэж нэрлэдэг.

options: The first rocket that reached the moon
The first weather balloon with a camera
questions.explain: "The next year, he successfully launched the world's first liquid-fuel rocket" гэж бичсэн. Өмнөх он нь 1925.

questions.prompt: Why did many people think Goddard was foolish?
options: He said a rocket could someday reach the moon
He used liquid fuel in all of his rockets
He took money from the Smithsonian Institution
questions.explain: Годдард пуужин хэзээ нэгэн цагт саранд хүрч болно гэж бичсэн ("a rocket someday reaching the moon"). Тэр үед энэ нь хэрэгжих боломжгүй мэт санагдаж байсан.
